item.title: Plug In
item.description:
Are you tired of the corporate neutering of your music? The predatory fees and contracts? Me too. Send a note and let’s see if we can make some powerful noise.

Send word below. No polished PR pitches, no algorithmic hype — just tell me who you are and what you have to say. If you have something meaningful to shout into the world, I want to know.

Open to anything; Punk prophets, country outlaws, rock poets or any socially conscious singer/songwriter who wants to make a difference.

item.title: About
item.description:
The Refocus

Imagine a 25-year IT engineering career vanishing, taken by an eye disease that steals your sight. It’s real.

After losing my career, it took five years in the wastelands to burn away the noise, strip out the optical illusions, and re-evaluate what matters.

Look around at the world; the greed, the suffering, the codifying of the human spirit, and it is painfully obvious that current social and cultural values and priorities are simply not working.
